title: Visible handwashing and exit flow

reference.title: Visible handwashing and exit flow
reference.scope: Reference for the visible actions in the bundled video, not a complete hygiene procedure. Hidden towel release and actual door opening are not required.

steps.label: Lower towel into bin
steps.criterion: The hand moves paper below the rim of a lined bin. Visible release is not required.

steps.label: Hold door handle through a towel
steps.criterion: The hand grips a visible door lever through paper. Actual door opening is not required.

steps.label: Dry hands with the towel
steps.criterion: Paper contacts the hands as they rub or fold it between them; continued pulling from the slot is different.

steps.label: Pull a paper towel
steps.criterion: A sheet is visibly pulled out of a wall dispenser slot. Holding paper nearby is not enough.

steps.label: Rinse under running water
steps.criterion: A visible flowing water stream contacts the hands. Foam alone is not rinsing.

steps.label: Rub hands with lather
steps.criterion: Hands rub with visible foam. Running water is not required.

steps.label: Dispense soap
steps.criterion: White soap appears on a palm beneath a dispenser; mechanism actuation may be occluded.

steps.reason: The hand and used white towel move into the opening below the lined bin rim.
steps.uncertainty: The hand and rim obscure the exact moment of towel release.
steps.label: Lower towel into bin

steps.reason: A hand grips the chrome door lever through a white paper towel.
steps.uncertainty: Actual door opening is not established.
steps.label: Hold door handle through a towel

steps.reason: Both hands rub and fold the white paper between palms beside the dispenser.
steps.label: Dry hands with the towel

steps.reason: A hand pulls a white sheet from the wall slot and then holds the separated towel.
steps.label: Pull a paper towel

steps.reason: A visible faucet stream contacts the hands while they move under it.
steps.uncertainty: A preceding crossfade obscures the exact transition from rubbing.
steps.label: Rinse under running water

steps.reason: Foamy hands rub palms, fingers and backs together over the sink; no running stream is visible in these cited views.
steps.uncertainty: Representative samples do not establish the exact rubbing boundaries.
steps.label: Rub hands with lather

steps.reason: A palm is held beneath the dispenser; white soap appears on the palm in the next sampled view.
steps.uncertainty: The dispensing mechanism is partly hidden by the hand.
steps.label: Dispense soap

time_note: Cited sample order, not continuous execution or exact action boundaries.
reviewer: Codex vision: actual MCP PNGs and chronological sheets viewed in this session after Qwen inference
method: Host-attested Codex visual review of actual MCP read_frame images; recorded review, not Qwen output or an inference API call.
scope_note: Visible sample evidence only. Not proof of uninterrupted execution, hidden door opening or towel release.
control_kind: Same recorded observations compared to reversed reference; deterministic order control, no new vision inference.
